title: Walking in the footsteps of the gladiators!
text: We were originally meant to go on this bike ride on Friday, but due to a short shortage of E bikes, the company contacted us and were able to accommodate us on the Thursday and we ended up having our own private tour with myself, my husband and our amazing guide Rigo. The E bikes were great and made the 45 minute ride out to Italica easy. To truly appreciate the archeological site that is Italica, you need a knowledgeable and passionate guide, and Rigo was definitely this. It was a incredible place to visit. We learnt so much. The highlight was definitely walking through the Coliseum’s tunnels
author: Honeysuckle123

title: Amazing Bike Ride and Visit to Italica with Danny
text: Awesome experience with our guide Danny! My boyfriend and I did this bike trip on a Friday morning in October and happened to be the only ones, so we were lucky enough to have a private tour out to Italica site and back. Danny was an awesome tour guide and gave a great tour of Italica, as well as telling us interesting things about Seville as we rode through on our way to the site. The Seville roads were a bit hectic, but Danny did a great job guiding us through. Bikes were in great condition and worked well and everyone at the tour operator was very friendly and welcoming. title: Exercise and archeology - nothing better!
text:
I did this e-bike tour to Italica earlier this week with Danny as our guide, and it was definitely one of the highlights of my time in Seville.

I was traveling solo but joined a group, and it was a very comfortable experience. Everyone did well on the bikes, helmets were provided, and the electric assist made the ride smooth and easy. The bikes were also very easy to maneuver, and once we were out of the city center, the riding was especially relaxed with very few obstructions.

title: Ruins of Italica by e-bike (Seville)
text: We took the 5 hour e-bike ride and tour of the Ruins of Italica, Seville. The meeting place was easy to find , with a supermarket and coffee shop nearby. Remember to have cash to pay to get into the ruins (€1.5). Our guide , Rigo, was excellent, extremely knowledgeable and helpful , a very safe guide making sure that we were safe riding and crossing roads etc. We had a coffee before going into the ruins. title: You must do this tour if you go to Seville!
text: This was,  without doubt, the highlight of our six day trip to Seville. Italica is a fantastic site and walking through it with a knowledgeable and enthusiastic guide was magic.  We had great weather and the whole e-bike experience exceeded our expectations.

title: What have the Romans done for us?
text: Fantastic morning out. The e-bikes were well maintained and worked like a charm. Our guide Danny was very informative and made sure we kept up at all times. Great way to see more of the city. The site itself was amazing and there were virtually no other tourists there.
